T: Took them eight goes to get Ripley right. Dinner gets one.
D: Two hundred years after her death, Ripley is cloned by military scientists who want what she was carrying.
P: Serve the snacks when the Betty docks with the Auriga and the smugglers come aboard with their cargo.
S: eight halves, one for every number on the tanks

Boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water for 10 minutes, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, half a tsp curry powder and salt and pepper until smooth. Pipe or spoon back into the 8 whites, dust with smoked paprika and scatter with chopped chives.
Warm cheese puffs, after Ripley's no-look shot

Bring 125ml water, 50g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil, tip in 75g plain flour and beat over the heat for 2 minutes. Cool 5 minutes, then beat in 2 eggs one at a time and stir in 70g grated gruyère and a grating of nutmeg. Pipe 16 balls onto a lined tray, top with another 10g gruyère and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and deep golden.
M: Fish stew, from the kitchen the crew swims through

Soften 1 sliced onion, 1 sliced fennel bulb, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp fennel seeds in 3 tbsp olive oil. Add a pinch of saffron, a strip of orange zest, a 400g tin of tomatoes, 1 litre fish stock and 400g sliced waxy potatoes and simmer for 20 minutes. Add 500g chunks of firm white fish for 4 minutes, then 300g peeled prawns for 3 minutes. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove and a pinch of cayenne for the rouille. Serve with toasted baguette and parsley.
W: sweet shortcrust with a zesty citrus custard, baked to a wobble, sharp enough to burn through

Line a 23cm tart tin with 1 sheet sweet shortcrust pastry, chill 20 minutes and blind bake at 180C for 20 minutes. Whisk 4 eggs with 150g caster sugar, the zest of 3 limes, 150ml lime juice and 150ml thickened cream. Pour into the shell and bake at 150C for 30 minutes until just set with a wobble. Cool and chill for 2 hours, then finish with more lime zest.
K: Betty smugglers' spiced rum and ginger
dark rum over ice with cinnamon clove syrup and lime, topped with spicy fizz

Simmer 60g brown sugar, 60ml water, 1 cinnamon stick and 3 cloves for 3 minutes and cool. Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 60ml dark rum, 15ml spiced syrup and the juice of half a lime to each. Top with ginger beer and a lime wedge.

s.note: Johner's snack, with a little one-on-one on the side.

d.note: Lemon vodka over ice. Ask Ripley what she did: "I died."

dishes.make_ahead: Boil and peel the eggs and mix the filling up to 1 day ahead, kept separate in the fridge; fill just before serving

steps.text: Lower the eggs into a pot of boiling water and cook for 10 minutes.
Lift into iced water and cool completely.
Peel the eggs and cut in half lengthways. Tip the yolks into a bowl.
Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, curry powder and salt and pepper until smooth.
Pipe or spoon the filling into the 8 whites, dust with the smoked paprika and scatter with the chives.

dishes.make_ahead: Pipe the raw puffs onto a tray and freeze up to 1 month ahead; bake from frozen, adding 5 minutes

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C and line a tray with baking paper. Bring the water, butter and salt to the boil in a saucepan.
Tip in the flour all at once and beat with a wooden spoon over the heat until it forms a smooth ball that leaves the sides, about 2 minutes.
Take off the heat and cool.
Beat in the eggs one at a time until glossy, then stir in most of the gruyère and the nutmeg.
Pipe or spoon 16 small balls onto the tray and top with the rest of the gruyère.
Bake until puffed, deep golden and crisp. Do not open the oven for the first 15 minutes.
Cool for a few minutes and serve warm.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the broth with the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; reheat and poach the seafood on the night

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, sliced, for the broth
orange, zest peeled in a strip
firm white fish fillets, in chunks
garlic clove, crushed, for the rouille

steps.text: Slice the onion, fennel, broth garlic and potatoes. Cut the fish into chunks and peel the prawns.
Heat the oil in a wide heavy pot and soften the onion, fennel, garlic and fennel seeds without browning.
Add the saffron, orange zest, tomatoes, stock and potatoes. Simmer until the potatoes are just tender.
Mix the mayonnaise with the rouille garlic and cayenne.
Slice the baguette and toast until golden.
Add the fish and simmer gently for 4 minutes, then add the prawns for 3 minutes more. Season with salt and pepper.
Ladle into wide bowls, scatter with parsley and serve with the toasts and rouille.

veg.make_ahead: Make the broth with the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; reheat, add the vegetables and poach the eggs on the night

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, sliced, for the broth
orange, zest peeled in a strip
garlic clove, crushed, for the rouille

steps.text: Slice the onion, fennel, broth garlic and potatoes. Cut the zucchini into chunks.
Heat the oil in a wide heavy pot and soften the onion, fennel, garlic and fennel seeds without browning.
Add the saffron, orange zest, tomatoes, stock and potatoes. Simmer until the potatoes are just tender.
Mix the mayonnaise with the rouille garlic and cayenne.
Slice the baguette and toast until golden.
Add the zucchini and beans and simmer for 5 minutes. Season, then crack the eggs into the barely simmering broth, cover and poach for 4 minutes.
Ladle into wide bowls with an egg in each, scatter with parsley and serve with the toasts and rouille.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake and chill the tart up to 1 day ahead, the chill takes 2 hours; zest the top just before serving

ingredients.item: sheet frozen sweet shortcrust pastry, thawed
limes, 3 zested, all juiced to make 150ml

steps.text: Line a 23cm loose-based tart tin with the pastry, prick the base and chill.
Heat the oven to 180C. Line the pastry with baking paper and rice, bake for 15 minutes, lift out the paper and bake 5 minutes more. Turn the oven down to 150C.
Whisk the eggs and sugar, then whisk in the zest of 3 limes, the lime juice and cream. Skim off any froth.
Pour into the warm shell and bake until just set with a slight wobble in the middle.
Cool, then chill until firm.
Grate over a little more lime zest and cut into wedges.

dishes.n: Betty smugglers' spiced rum and ginger
dishes.make_ahead: Make and cool the spiced syrup up to 1 week ahead and keep it in the fridge; build the drinks to order

steps.text: Simmer the brown sugar, water, cinnamon and cloves for 3 minutes.
Cool the syrup and strain.
Fill 4 glasses with ice. Add the rum, the spiced syrup and the lime juice, sharing it between the glasses.
Top with the ginger beer, stir once and add a lime wedge.

af.n: Betty smugglers' spiced tea and ginger
af.make_ahead: Brew and chill the tea and make the spiced syrup up to 3 days ahead, both in the fridge; build the drinks to order

steps.text: Brew the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out and stir in the vanilla.
Simmer the brown sugar, syrup water, cinnamon and cloves for 3 minutes.
Cool the tea and syrup in the fridge and strain the syrup.
Fill 4 glasses with ice. Add the cold tea, the spiced syrup and the lime juice, sharing it between the glasses.
Top with the ginger beer, stir once and add a lime wedge.
